knownDeltas: The HTTP status is the engine convention (401 for a missing credential, 403 for a wrong one) while the envelope code stays Esri's 498/497; ArcGIS Server answers 200-by-default with the envelope code only. The status/code split is strict and pinned here.
name: token-required-498
notes: Admin listing without a credential while a token is configured: the replay pins the 401/498 contract (missing token; a wrong token is 403/497, pinned by EsriErrorMapperTests).
source: Esri REST docs: token-based security (498 token required / 499 token cancelled lineage); the admin projection is ADR-0041 section 6
